bull_bear.body:
- Our operations involve providing turnkey furnishing solutions for the interiors of new railway coaches, as well as the refurbishment, up gradation, and conversion of existing coaches, including the modernization of toilet facilities and manufacturing and supply of components to railways.
- In selecting contractors, Indian Railways generally limits the tender to contractors, who have pre-qualifications based on several criteria including experience, technological capacity and performance, reputation for quality, safety record, financial strength and bonding capacity and size of previous contracts.
- We are subject to strict quality requirements and customer inspections, and any failure to comply with quality standards may lead to rework/replacement of existing and future orders and could negatively impact our reputation and our business and results of operations and future prospects.
- We are engaged in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, focusing on the design, manufacture and maintenance of railway coaches interior.
- We provide turnkey furnishing solutions for the interiors of new railway coaches, refurbishment, up- gradation and conversion of old coaches and up-gradation of toilet facilities within railway coaches, along with manufacturing and supply of components to railways.
- Given the nature of our products and the sector in which we operate, we believe that our customers have high standards for product quality and delivery schedules.
- Adherence to quality standards is a critical factor as a defect in products manufactured by our Company or failure to comply with the specifications of our customers may, in turn, lead to the manufacture of faulty end products.
- This may lead to rework/replacement of supply orders by our customers and at certain instances may impose additional costs in the form of product liability and/or product recall.

business.body: The company designs, manufactures and supplies railway coach interior furnishing products and services for Indian Railways, operating on a tender-based model. Its revenue lines for FY2025-26 were Supply - Electrical and Others Rs 14,006.81 lakhs (53.23% of total sales), Up gradation of Toilet Rs 5,798.86 lakhs (22.04%), Refurbishment, Up-gradation and Conversion Rs 2,477.17 lakhs (9.41%), Turnkey Furnishing Rs 2,181.72 lakhs (8.29%), and Others (Service & Job work) Rs 1,850.24 lakhs (7.03%), against total revenue from contracts and services of Rs 26,314.81 lakhs. All tender activities happen through IREPS, the Indian Railways e-procurement portal, and customers are Indian Railways and its affiliates as well as private clients for supply. As of June 30, 2026, the order book was Rs 73,797.33 lakhs across 40 orders, comprising Toilet Upgradation Rs 34,627.82 lakhs (46.92%), Supply - Private Clients Rs 22,908.86 lakhs (31.04%), Refurbishment, Upgradation/Conversion of Coaches Rs 6,736.43 lakhs (9.13%), Turnkey Furnishing Rs 6,278.64 lakhs (8.51%) and Supply - Indian Railways Rs 3,245.58 lakhs (4.40%). The company undertakes turnkey furnishing of new coaches including LHB variants and Vande Bharat at the Modern Coach Factory, Raebareli, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala; refurbishment and conversion of old LHB and ICF coaches at railway workshops; and upgradation of toilet facilities in LHB and ICF coaches. Since 2017 it has completed 28 turnkey furnishing projects covering 1,610 coaches, refurbished and upgraded 1,888 coaches since 2018, and completed 10,948 toilet upgrade units till June 30, 2026, across 16 railway zones, 3 production units, 2 mid-life rehabilitation units and 28 coach variants. It also manufactures Braille signage, FRP products and sanitary ware made of aluminum polymer composite, and supplies epoxy flooring, decorative glass fabric reinforced plastic, toilet doors, compartment doors, seat and berth, fire barrier decorative coating and vacuum circuit breakers. Raw material purchases were Rs 8,351.25 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and Rs 7,232.55 lakhs in Fiscal 2025, sourced from third-party suppliers in India. The company has one manufacturing unit in Sonipat, Haryana, covering over 92,000 square feet, with a laboratory and testing equipment. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified by TUV Nord Group, Germany and ISO 15085 certified by UK Certification & Inspection for welding.

overview.business_model: The company designs, manufactures and supplies railway coach interior furnishing products and services for Indian Railways, operating on a tender-based model. Its revenue lines for FY2025-26 were Supply - Electrical and Others Rs 14,006.81 lakhs (53.23% of total sales), Up gradation of Toilet Rs 5,798.86 lakhs (22.04%), Refurbishment, Up-gradation and Conversion Rs 2,477.17 lakhs (9.41%), Turnkey Furnishing Rs 2,181.72 lakhs (8.29%), and Others (Service & Job work) Rs 1,850.24 lakhs (7.03%), against total revenue from contracts and services of Rs 26,314.81 lakhs. All tender activities happen through IREPS, the Indian Railways e-procurement portal, and customers are Indian Railways and its affiliates as well as private clients for supply. As of June 30, 2026, the order book was Rs 73,797.33 lakhs across 40 orders, comprising Toilet Upgradation Rs 34,627.82 lakhs (46.92%), Supply - Private Clients Rs 22,908.86 lakhs (31.04%), Refurbishment, Upgradation/Conversion of Coaches Rs 6,736.43 lakhs (9.13%), Turnkey Furnishing Rs 6,278.64 lakhs (8.51%) and Supply - Indian Railways Rs 3,245.58 lakhs (4.40%). The company undertakes turnkey furnishing of new coaches including LHB variants and Vande Bharat at the Modern Coach Factory, Raebareli, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala; refurbishment and conversion of old LHB and ICF coaches at railway workshops; and upgradation of toilet facilities in LHB and ICF coaches. Since 2017 it has completed 28 turnkey furnishing projects covering 1,610 coaches, refurbished and upgraded 1,888 coaches since 2018, and completed 10,948 toilet upgrade units till June 30, 2026, across 16 railway zones, 3 production units, 2 mid-life rehabilitation units and 28 coach variants. It also manufactures Braille signage, FRP products and sanitary ware made of aluminum polymer composite, and supplies epoxy flooring, decorative glass fabric reinforced plastic, toilet doors, compartment doors, seat and berth, fire barrier decorative coating and vacuum circuit breakers. Raw material purchases were Rs 8,351.25 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and Rs 7,232.55 lakhs in Fiscal 2025, sourced from third-party suppliers in India. The company has one manufacturing unit in Sonipat, Haryana, covering over 92,000 square feet, with a laboratory and testing equipment. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified by TUV Nord Group, Germany and ISO 15085 certified by UK Certification & Inspection for welding.

As of June 30, 2026, the order book was Rs 73,797.33 lakhs across 40 orders, comprising Toilet Upgradation Rs 34,627.82 lakhs (46.92%), Supply - Private Clients Rs 22,908.86 lakhs (31.04%), Refurbishment, Upgradation/Conversion of Coaches Rs 6,736.43 lakhs (9.13%), Turnkey Furnishing Rs 6,278.64 lakhs (8.51%) and Supply - Indian Railways Rs 3,245.58 lakhs (4.40%). The company undertakes turnkey furnishing of new coaches including LHB variants and Vande Bharat at the Modern Coach Factory, Raebareli, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala; refurbishment and conversion of old LHB and ICF coaches at railway workshops; and upgradation of toilet facilities in LHB and ICF coaches. Since 2017 it has completed 28 turnkey furnishing projects covering 1,610 coaches, refurbished and upgraded 1,888 coaches since 2018, and completed 10,948 toilet upgrade units till June 30, 2026, across 16 railway zones, 3 production units, 2 mid-life rehabilitation units and 28 coach variants. It also manufactures Braille signage, FRP products and sanitary ware made of aluminum polymer composite, and supplies epoxy flooring, decorative glass fabric reinforced plastic, toilet doors, compartment doors, seat and berth, fire barrier decorative coating and vacuum circuit breakers. Raw material purchases were Rs 8,351.25 lakhs in Fiscal 2026 and Rs 7,232.55 lakhs in Fiscal 2025, sourced from third-party suppliers in India. The company has one manufacturing unit in Sonipat, Haryana, covering over 92,000 square feet, with a laboratory and testing equipment. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified by TUV Nord Group, Germany and ISO 15085 certified by UK Certification & Inspection for welding.

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Our operations involve providing turnkey furnishing solutions for the interiors of new railway coaches, as well as the refurbishment, up gradation, and conversion of existing coaches, including the modernization of toilet facilities and manufacturing and supply of components to railways.
- In selecting contractors, Indian Railways generally limits the tender to contractors, who have pre-qualifications based on several criteria including experience, technological capacity and performance, reputation for quality, safety record, financial strength and bonding capacity and size of previous contracts.
- We are subject to strict quality requirements and customer inspections, and any failure to comply with quality standards may lead to rework/replacement of existing and future orders and could negatively impact our reputation and our business and results of operations and future prospects.
- We are engaged in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, focusing on the design, manufacture and maintenance of railway coaches interior.
- We provide turnkey furnishing solutions for the interiors of new railway coaches, refurbishment, up- gradation and conversion of old coaches and up-gradation of toilet facilities within railway coaches, along with manufacturing and supply of components to railways.
- Given the nature of our products and the sector in which we operate, we believe that our customers have high standards for product quality and delivery schedules.
- Adherence to quality standards is a critical factor as a defect in products manufactured by our Company or failure to comply with the specifications of our customers may, in turn, lead to the manufacture of faulty end products.
- This may lead to rework/replacement of supply orders by our customers and at certain instances may impose additional costs in the form of product liability and/or product recall.
